label.purpose: Dates, counts, status and supporting labels.

components.name: New session
components.description: Compact plain native button: 44 pt minimum, subheadline semibold, Theme accent fill/text, 12 pt corners; no shared pressable padding or scaling.

components.name: Preparation
components.description: Outlined native preparation button; preserves busy and disabled states.

components.name: Patient identity and compact goal
components.description: Layered PatientHeaderBackdrop behind hidden toolbar background: Explicit existing dark navy #0C1420 in both appearances plus patient accent lights, translucent diagonal planes and bottom shade. Geometry tracks headerBottom and top safe area; lower corners24. Avatar48 uses existing palette/contrast. Goal dark ultraThinMaterial at .25 and border .22. Reduce Transparency omits facets. Native captures reviewed against the illustrative reference. Status capsule uses black .22; AccountActionNotices background excludes safe-area edges. Final dark/light render checks passed. Compact header spacing6/bottom8; ScaledMetric24 relative to title2. Final initial-fit test passed after root-gap6 correction.

components.css: .ds-preview{direction:rtl;font-family:system-ui;background:#0C1420;color:white;padding:16px}.ds-identity{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#0000002E),linear-gradient(60deg,transparent 25%,#FFFFFF0B 25%,#FFFFFF0B 45%,transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at top right,#4C9AFF6B,transparent 85%),linear-gradient(to bottom left,#4C9AFF9E,#4C9AFF1F),#0C1420}.ds-person{display:flex;align-items:start;gap:12px}.ds-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:48px;height:48px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(to bottom left,#4C9AFF,#4C9AFFAD);color:black;border:1px solid #FFFFFF3D}.ds-name{font-size:24px;font-weight:700}.ds-person p{color:white;background:#00000038;border-radius:999px;display:inline-block;padding:3px 8px}.ds-goalhead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #FFFFFF38;border-radius:10px;padding:4px 10px;background:#17223140;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}.ds-goalhead span{flex:1}.ds-action{font:inherit;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-expand{border:0;background:transparent;color:white}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid white;outline-offset:3px}.ds-action:hover{filter:brightness(1.05)}.ds-action:active{opacity:.85}.ds-goaltext{font-weight:500;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}@media(prefers-reduced-transparency:reduce){.ds-identity{background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#0000002E),radial-gradient(circle at top right,#4C9AFF6B,transparent 85%),linear-gradient(to bottom left,#4C9AFF9E,#4C9AFF1F),#0C1420}}

components.name: Record destination
components.description: Bordered record button inside shared 16 pt record enclosure with heading, four destinations, AI, notes and messages; 8 pt outer padding, 4 pt vertical gaps and 8 pt column gaps. Accessibility grid uses one column.

components.name: AI chat
components.description: Full-width violet AI action with native Color.purple icon, 14% fill and 65% outline. CSS purple is illustrative, not a normative native color value.
components.css: .ds-preview{direction:rtl;font-family:system-ui;background:#0C1420;color:#F3F5F8;padding:16px}.ds-action{font:inherit;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #E2BB76;outline-offset:3px}.ds-action:hover{filter:brightness(1.05)}.ds-action:active{opacity:.85}@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.ds-preview{background:#F1F4F8;color:#182C46}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline-color:#285A8C}}.ds-chat{width:100%;text-align:start;background:#172231;color:#E2BB76;border:0;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:600}@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.ds-chat{background:#FFFFFF;color:#285A8C}}.ds-chat{background:color-mix(in srgb,purple 14%,transparent);color:inherit;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,purple 65%,transparent);border-radius:12px;padding:0 10px;min-height:44px}@media(prefers-color-scheme:light){.ds-chat{background:color-mix(in srgb,purple 14%,transparent);color:inherit}}

components.name: Horizontal recorded journey
components.description: Over the shared layered backdrop; no separate heading in header. Stage controls open timeline. Oldest RIGHT/newest LEFT; >4 stages each use one quarter container width and target latest on appearance/group-ID changes. Full timeline/accessibility fallback newest TOP. Compact-layout final fit and long-journey tests passed.

narrative.overview:
This document captures the rebuilt native iOS PatientDetailView only. Final compact-layout verification passed: 2 journey unit tests and 5 iPhone UI tests using synthetic data. At default text size, AI, notes and messages are initially hittable and the notes control clears the tab bar; large text remains scrollable. This document describes current source behavior and makes no claim of pixel-perfect mockup fidelity. Its calm, compact treatment workspace uses the existing CBTipul navy/gold identity and adaptive Theme.swift values. It establishes no new app-wide visual identity and does not apply the screen composition to Android, the web workspace, or other iOS screens.

Existing brand tokens remain authoritative in ios/Theme.swift. The approved screen composition and interaction contract live in .impeccable/surfaces/ios-patient-detail.md, with the A-horizontal and C-patient-color approval recorded in .impeccable/mocks/patient-horizontal/approval.json; PRODUCT.md supplies the Hebrew, accessibility, and clinical privacy constraints. The UI presents recorded activity without implying clinical improvement.
keyCharacteristics: Native Hebrew RTL navigation and system typography.
Existing adaptive navy/gold and cool light surfaces.
Compact recorded activity with explicit, accessible actions.
Patient-color identity header and horizontal recorded journey.
dos: Do preserve adaptive Theme body surfaces, layered patient-hue backdrop and the scoped native purple AI treatment.
Do preserve Hebrew RTL order, readable wrapping, Dynamic Type and labeled native actions.
Do preserve all existing destinations and safety behavior.
Do derive activity counts and journey groups from recorded data.
Do place the newest stage at the left horizontally and at the top vertically.
Do derive header and journey colors from the existing patient palette, using white header text and adaptive body text.
donts: Don't apply this screen's composition as an app-wide redesign.
Don't invent clinical summaries, progress stages, scores or trends.
Don't use color alone to express connection, failure or clinical meaning.
Don't replace native iOS interactions with web-style controls.
